tie_reference: TIE (2026). History for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.
source_note: Verified History Form One scheme of work for Term I (TIE 2026 curriculum), weeks 1-20, 3 periods per week. Week 10 carries the mid-term examination; Weeks 17-19 include comprehensive terminal revision and a mock test; Week 20 is the official terminal examination. Rows derived from the educator-provided lesson-plan set (Arusha Secondary School).
